title: Zesty Russian Chorizo Gratin
description: A tangy, molten gratin featuring smoked salmon layered with spiced potatoes, perfect for a solo dinner in a wood-fired oven.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 200°C and light a small wood fire to maintain steady heat.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat, add onion and garlic, and sauté until translucent.
Stir in smoked paprika and turmeric, cooking for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add potato slices to the skillet, season with salt and pepper, and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Transfer the potato mixture to a baking dish, layer with smoked salmon slices, and sprinkle chopped dill on top.
Sprinkle shredded Gruyère evenly over the layers and add a pinch of crushed red pepper flakes.
Place the baking dish on a preheated grill grate over the wood fire, cover with a lid or foil, and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the lid and bake an additional 10 minutes until the cheese is golden and bubbly.
Let the gratin rest for 5 minutes before serving hot, optionally garnishing with a drizzle of olive oil.
